Messages.Body:
When playing aggressive tactics on someone, their hand size is reduced but
is the extra card(s) discarded at random or chosen by the Methuselah?
What about Raptor?
Thanks, P.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
> When playing aggressive tactics on someone, their hand size is reduced but
> is the extra card(s) discarded at random or chosen by the Methuselah?
> What about Raptor?

Chosen by the Methuselah. All discards are chosen, by default. Explicit card
text is requires to change that (cf. Dr. Jest).
